name: Return of Zero — A/C, Root of the Conjugate Field
description: The canonical dual-form root as its own small expression: the one 0/1 field, its frozen ethic carried by reference, the crossed-zero sequence, the primitive sixfold, and the shared close.

scenes.name: A/C — Argument / Concept — Root of the Conjugate Field
scenes.character: The root as one self-describing field.

entities.name: the ground the mark links without becoming

text.title: A/C is the full 0/1 field
text.body: One field, two faces; the mark that names them both.

scenes.name: A face — the ruling: Respect for Experience
scenes.character: The ethic every conjugate operation answers to; linked, never rewritten.

entities.name: the frozen plate — the ethic carried by reference
Traversal — facticity to dignity to love

text.title: Experience becomes a ruling
text.body: Respect for experience: the field's own ethic.

scenes.name: The crossed-zero recognition sequence
scenes.character: Occlusion, mediation, field-availability, recognition — run as a live sequence.

entities.name: the arc the recognition returns along

text.title: The means can forget that it is the means
text.body: Ground and manifestation recognised as one relation.

scenes.name: C face — the concept: the primitive field
scenes.character: The sixfold constitution of the field; recursion does not terminate.

text.title: The condition operating as the form of its own determination
text.body: Six offices of one local movement, recursive at every level.

scenes.name: The shared close — thinging / conditioning
scenes.character: The ruling as the field’s constitution; the field as the ruling’s only body.

entities.name: the A face above — the ruling
the C face below — the constitution
Traversal — the two orientations of one relation

text.title: A turn of the relation, not a second ontology
text.body: Ground toward manifestation; determination toward its whole.
